## Checklist

- [ ] Targets `dev`
- [ ] `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/`, `docs/website/`) and an entry under **Unreleased** in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No change to script hashes, chain ids, journal tables or `--json` output, or it's discussed in an issue
